classes.label: OS & iOS Updates
classes.description: System software updates (iOS, macOS, watchOS), update installation freezes, post-update performance degradation, UI glitches, autocorrect anomalies, and crash loops.
canonical_examples: My iPhone has been stuck on 'Verifying update' for iOS 11 for over 3 hours. How do I fix this?
Why does my keyboard keep changing the letter 'I' into an 'A' with a symbol?
Updated to iOS 11.0.3 and now my apps crash every time I swipe up.

classes.label: Battery & Hardware
classes.description: Power delivery issues, rapid battery depletion, unexpected shutdowns, thermal overheating, physical screen fractures, swelling batteries, broken physical buttons, or liquid immersion.
canonical_examples: My iPhone 7 battery percentage drops from 80% to 15% in less than an hour and the back gets burning hot.
My phone fell down stairs, screen shattered completely and battery is visibly swollen.
My lightning cable won't charge my phone unless I hold it at a specific angle.

classes.label: Apple ID & Account
classes.description: User authentication, Apple ID recovery, Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) verification codes, locked accounts, password reset loops, iCloud account syncing, or country/region migration.
canonical_examples: I'm locked out of my Apple ID because I changed my mobile number and cannot receive the two-factor code.
Need help changing the region on my Apple ID so I can download UK apps.
Forgot my Apple ID password and the recovery email is no longer accessible.

classes.label: Connectivity & Wi-Fi
classes.description: Wireless connectivity protocols including Wi-Fi network disconnection, Bluetooth peripheral discovery, cellular reception/SIM errors, AirDrop failures, Home Sharing media streaming, and hotspot drops.
canonical_examples: Why does my Wi-Fi keep disconnecting every time my phone locks?
My iPhone won't connect to my car Bluetooth after updating to iOS 11.
Phone shows 'Searching...' for cellular service for past 2 hours even with full SIM.

classes.label: Audio & Accessories
classes.description: Audio hardware and peripherals including AirPods (pairing, case charging, single earbud failure), EarPods, Lightning-to-3.5mm headphone jack adapters, microphone muffled audio, speaker crackling, and Apple Watch accessories.
canonical_examples: My right AirPod won't connect or charge in the case, only the left one works.
The lightning headphone adapter has static noise when I move the cord.
Callers say my voice sounds muffled when using speakerphone on iPhone 8.

classes.label: Billing & Subscriptions
classes.description: Financial transactions, credit card charges from ITUNES.COM/BILL, accidental in-app purchases, recurring subscription cancellation, refund requests, and family sharing payment disputes.
canonical_examples: I was charged $9.99 on my bank statement from Apple for an app I never downloaded. I want a refund.
How do I cancel my Apple Music trial before it auto-renews tomorrow?
My child made accidental in-app purchases on Roblox, how can I reverse the charges?

classes.label: General Support
classes.description: Retail Apple Store operating hours, product reservations (e.g. iPhone X launch pickup), marketing questions, general feedback, or ambiguous inquiries.
canonical_examples: Hello, are all the phone support lines closed for tonight?
I got an email saying my iPhone X is reserved for the 3rd, how do I confirm pickup?
Where is the nearest Apple Store in London open on Sunday?

disambiguation_rules.title: Physical Hazard / Swollen Battery Overrides Software Update
disambiguation_rules.condition_description: If a customer mentions an iOS update in conjunction with physical hardware hazards (swollen battery, cracked screen, burning hot chassis), classify under BATTERY_POWER_HARDWARE due to safety and repair requirements.
disambiguation_rules.example: After installing the iOS 11 update my iPhone battery became swollen and pushed the screen out.

disambiguation_rules.title: Unauthorized Charge Overrides General Store Inquiry
disambiguation_rules.condition_description: If a customer asks about a store or receipt in connection with an unauthorized fee or refund request, classify as SUBSCRIPTIONS_BILLING due to financial risk.
disambiguation_rules.example: I checked my receipt and noticed an unauthorized subscription charge from iTunes billing, need refund.

disambiguation_rules.title: Audio Peripheral Specificity Over General Bluetooth
disambiguation_rules.condition_description: If an audio accessory (AirPods, Bluetooth headphones) fails to connect, classify under AUDIO_ACCESSORIES rather than CONNECTIVITY_NETWORKING.
disambiguation_rules.example: My AirPods won't connect via Bluetooth to my MacBook.

disambiguation_rules.title: Account & 2FA Lockout Overrides App Store Update
disambiguation_rules.condition_description: If a customer cannot download updates because their Apple ID is disabled or 2FA fails, classify under ACCOUNT_APPLE_ID.
disambiguation_rules.example: I cannot update any apps because my Apple ID has been disabled for security reasons.

disambiguation_rules.title: Low Confidence or Empty Technical Detail Fallback
disambiguation_rules.condition_description: When no technical signals or domain keywords match, or confidence across all technical classes is below 0.50, route to GENERAL_INQUIRY.
disambiguation_rules.example: Can someone please help me right now?

metadata.derivation_methodology: Empirical n-gram mining, TF-IDF term frequency analysis, and operational routing constraint mapping
